description: CV recording sequencer: it samples a voltage as it moves from step to step while recording, then plays the stored voltages back in order; up to 32 steps and 16 polyphonic channels

params.text: Sets how many steps the sequence runs for, 1 to 32
Sets the internal clock rate, 15 BPM at the bottom of its travel and 3840 BPM at the top
Advances the sequence by one step, sampling a voltage as it goes if recording is on
Sends the sequence back to its first step
Sets the voltage that is recorded when nothing is patched to the input, -5V to 5V
Runs and stops the sequencer, as a toggle or while held down depending on its Trig/Gate switch
Turns recording on and off, as a toggle or while held down depending on its Trig/Gate switch
Chooses how the start button and start input work: Trig toggles running on each rising edge, Gate runs the sequencer only while the signal is high
Chooses how the record button and record input work: Trig toggles recording on each rising edge, Gate records only while the signal is high
Chooses where a sampled voltage is stored: Pre puts it in the step the sequencer is leaving, Post in the step it is arriving at
Stops recording by itself as the sequence rolls over from its last step back to the first

inputs.text: Adds one step to the sequence length per volt
Every volt doubles the internal clock rate
The voltage sampled into each step while recording, and its channel count sets the polyphony; with nothing patched here the module records the position of its own voltage knob
A rising edge advances the sequence by one step
A rising edge sends the sequence back to its first step
Runs and stops the sequencer, toggling on a rising edge or running while high depending on the Trig/Gate switch
Turns recording on and off, toggling on a rising edge or recording while high depending on the Trig/Gate switch

outputs.text: The stored voltage of the current step, or the incoming voltage while recording

notes: The module comes up stopped and not recording: Start runs the sequencer and Rec stores the incoming voltage into the steps as it moves.
Every step holds 0V until it has been recorded into, so the output is flat on a module that has never recorded.
menu: Polyphony Channels — a submenu offering Auto and 1 to 16, fixing the number of channels recorded and played back; Auto follows the channel count of the input
